Government Decides Against Capping Airfares for Festive Season

The Indian government has decided not to cap airfares for the upcoming festive season. Minister Rammohan Naidu stated that airlines have been asked to keep fares reasonable during this period. This decision means there will be no government-imposed upper limit on ticket prices.
